name: Free
intro: Envelopes, sequencers, clocks, macro controllers, oscillators, physical models, mixers and effects. This is the core of CV funk, and it's where many of the best modules live. Free and open source.

name: Modulations

videos.title: CV funk Modulations overview and tutorial

tagline: For 16-voice polyphonic workflows, and an experimental complex oscillator.
intro: SYZYGY, a complex oscillator grown from OUROS, alongside 16-channel takes on the sequencer (ARRANGE XL), the envelope generator (ENVELOPE CITY) and the LFO (SUPER WONK).

name: Chord Caster
tagline: For automating and sequencing chords and complex strumming rhythms.
intro: CHORD CASTER sequences chords, voicings and strum patterns bar by bar through its own six-voice oscillator, modulation, mixer and delay. Every step can recall all 42 knobs and 20 buttons. POLY MAP and CHORDY extend it.

name: Sands

videos.title: Exploring CV funk Sands: 5 generative patches

intro: A self-contained ecosystem that needs few other modules: physical models (DROPLET, STRANDS), a living desert (SIROCCO), morphing oscillators (ZEPHYR, DRIFTS), probabilistic routing (ARCS), displaced rhythms (CROSSWINDS, DUNES) and a chord-aware quantizer (MIRAGE).
